title: Common rules
description: Check that a value is present, or that it is an object.

title: String rules
description: Compare and measure strings. Numbers are validated as strings.

title: Numeric rules
description: Check numbers and strings that look like numbers, and return them as numbers.

title: Special rules
description: Emails, URLs, dates, and comparison with another field.

title: Metarules
description: Describe nested objects, lists and alternatives with other rules.

title: Modifiers
description: Change the data. Modifiers never return errors.
